title: Guardian Connect
body:
Since Medtronic is reaaaaally slow at releasing an Android App or even update the iOS one to be considered a competition for Dexcom, is it possible to get it to work with xDrip?

I i am stuck with an iPhone because of it and i would love to change the device.

comments.body: For now only in combination with android uploader phone with the BG Meyer attached via OTG cable.
@hartlijn that's for the Pump combination. Guardian Connect is a standalone bluetooth transmitter.
